English: Wicker Stand
A simple shrine made from interwoven branches, serving as a primitive focus for South Slavic prayers and offerings.
Prayer Hut
A modest wooden hut, roofed with thatch, where the clan gathers for communal prayers and small ceremonies.
Ancestors Pavilion
A larger, open-air structure adorned with icons and symbols of honored ancestors, fostering greater unity and tradition.
Spirit Shelter
A sturdy wooden shelter, decorated with sacred carvings and spirit totems, providing a spiritual heart for the clan.
Priests Room
Private quarters for the clans priest, enabling more elaborate rituals and closer guidance for the faithful.
Blessed Glade
A sacred grove, carefully tended and circled with stones, held to be a place of powerful communion with the gods.
Sanctified Hall
A grand timber hall, decorated with sacred symbols and relics, serving as a center for the most important clan rites.
Diviners Chamber
A secluded chamber for the clans diviner, dedicated to prophecy, dream interpretation, and strengthening unity.
Shrine Pavilion
A resplendent pavilion of carved wood and stone, housing sacred images and relics, a spiritual beacon for the entire clan.
South Slavic Sanctuary
The ultimate religious center for South Slavic nomads: a magnificent sanctuary of timber and stone, adorned with the symbols of gods and ancestors, uniting the clan in faith and spirit.
